title: When a CNF formula evaluates to negative one
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\psi$ be a CNF formula on $n$ variables, and let $x$ be an assignment in the sign cube of dimension $n$. Then $\psi$ evaluates to $-1$ at $x$ if and only if every clause of $\psi$ evaluates to $-1$ at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $\psi$ is a CNF formula on $n$ variables
$x$ is an assignment in the sign cube of dimension $n$
